<command>uv run pytest -q tests/test_format.py</command>
I expect a failure caused by unrounded heights, not an import error or typo. If the tests still pass without the rounding, they don't test it. In that case I'd fix the tests and stop to tell you before going further.

3. Re-apply the minimal rounding to 0.01 m in `tides/format.py`. It's the same small change as before, written fresh against the failing test. I can't give the exact lines here because I don't have the file's contents in front of me.

4. Verify GREEN on the file:
<command>uv run pytest -q tests/test_format.py</command>

I'd fix only what my change broke, such as golden station tables whose expected heights now differ at the third decimal. If the golden files need re-recording, I'd ask you first, since that changes recorded data.
